mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_codes(email,purpose,code_hash,expires_at,attempts) VALUES(#{email},#{purpose},#{codeHash},#{expiresAt},0) ON CONFLICT(email,purpose) DO UPDATE SET code_hash=excluded.code_hash,expires_at=excluded.expires_at,attempts=0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM email_codes WHERE email=#{email} AND purpose=#{purpose}
mapper.select: SELECT code_hash,expires_at,attempts FROM email_codes WHERE email=#{email} AND purpose=#{purpose}
mapper.update: UPDATE email_codes SET attempts=attempts+1 WHERE email=#{email} AND purpose=#{purpose}
mapper.select: SELECT secret_ciphertext,enabled FROM user_totp WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT secret_ciphertext,enabled FROM user_totp WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND enabled=1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_totp(user_id,secret_ciphertext,enabled,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{secretCiphertext},0,#{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET secret_ciphertext=excluded.secret_ciphertext,enabled=0,updated_at=excluded.updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE user_totp SET enabled=1,updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(enabled),0) FROM user_totp WHERE user_id=#{userId}
